verdict.rationale: Xero documents customizable invoice templates, a 'Pay now' button for online payment collection with automatic reconciliation, and Stripe-based online payment acceptance, directly supporting create/send invoices with online payment. View/paid tracking is implied via automatic reconciliation but not explicitly documented as a 'viewed' status feature. missing for 10: explicit documentation of invoice 'viewed' tracking/read-receipt status, independent hands-on corroboration beyond vendor pages.
